actions.reason: C0001 has a coherent RNA-defined biological identity with multiple significant pathways and large effect sizes (e.g., HEME_METABOLISM, PANCREAS_BETA_CELLS, COAGULATION). Although WXS and CNV are not significant, the RNA signal is strong and biologically interpretable. Technical confounding is not significant at set level, and structural evidence does not positively support Split or Merge. Retaining for downstream validation is better supported than dropping.

C0002 lacks significant biological support across all modalities (RNA, WXS, CNV) with no pathways or mutations reaching FDR significance. Cross-modal consistency is modest but not strong, and there is no coherent biological identity. Technical confounding is not significant, but the absence of positive identity evidence makes retention indefensible. No structural correction or resolvable evidence request is available.

C0003 shows a coherent biological identity with significant RNA pathways (PANCREAS_BETA_CELLS, HEME_METABOLISM) and a CNV feature (chr20q) reaching FDR significance. PBRM1 mutation enrichment is strong in effect size though not FDR-significant. Technical confounding is not significant at set level. Structural evidence does not support Split or Merge. Retaining for downstream validation is better supported than dropping.

C0004 has a strong RNA-defined identity with 16 significant pathways, including downregulation of immune and inflammatory pathways (ALLOGRAFT_REJECTION, TNFA_SIGNALING_VIA_NFKB) and upregulation of HEME_METABOLISM. Although WXS and CNV are not significant, the RNA signal is coherent and large in effect. Technical confounding is not significant at set level. Structural evidence does not support Split or Merge. Retaining is better supported than dropping.

C0005 has no significant biological support in RNA, WXS, or CNV. More importantly, it shows strong and significant technical associations with multiple acquisition parameters (e.g., tissue_source_site B8, ct_phase NEPH, ct_manufacturer SIEMENS, ct_reconstruction_kernel STANDARD), providing a substantial alternative explanation for any observed differences. The set is likely confounded by technical factors, and there is no coherent biological identity. Dropping is better supported than retaining.

C0006 has only one significant RNA pathway (EMT) and no significant WXS or CNV findings. The set is small (n=9) and the evidence is suggestive but not robust. Cross-modal consistency is weak, and technical confounding is not significant but the biological identity is not sufficiently coherent. No structural correction or resolvable evidence request is available. Dropping is better supported than retaining.

C0007 has a strong RNA-defined identity with 14 significant pathways, including downregulation of MYOGENESIS and WNT_BETA_CATENIN_SIGNALING and upregulation of inflammatory pathways. BAP1 mutation enrichment is strong in effect size (OR=8.75) though not FDR-significant. Technical confounding is not significant at set level. Structural evidence does not support Split or Merge. Retaining for downstream validation is better supported than dropping.

C0008 has only two members, making all analyses underpowered and unreliable. No significant findings in any modality, and internal structure cannot be estimated. The set lacks sufficient evidence to justify retention. No structural correction or resolvable evidence request is available. Dropping is better supported than retaining.
